name: The Destruction
description: Sturdy damage dealers who trade HP for power and fight at the front.

name: The Hunt
description: Precise hunters that eliminate one high-value target at a time.

name: The Erudition
description: Scholars of annihilation who strike every enemy at once.

name: The Harmony
description: Supports who amplify allies with buffs, energy and action advance.

name: The Nihility
description: Weakens enemies with debuffs and damage over time.

name: The Preservation
description: Protectors who shield allies and draw enemy attacks.

name: The Abundance
description: Healers who restore HP and cleanse debuffs.

name: The Remembrance
description: Summon memosprites that act alongside the team.
